annotations.title: Which loans fit a mobile home park, and how much

description: Runs the Pad Count loan sizer on one mobile home park: for Fannie Mae MHC, Freddie Mac MHC, HUD 223(f) MHC and the user's own bank or CMBS terms it returns a verdict (fits, check first, doesn't fit), the loan amount (the smaller of value x max LTV and NOI / (coverage x loan constant)), which limit binds, the rate used (Treasury for the term plus a spread) and every published rule the park fails. SBA 7(a) and 504 come back as not eligible, with the SOP quote.

borrower.description: Borrower type: private, resident_owned (ROC or co-op), nonprofit, government (state or local), cdfi or tribe. Default private.

current_balance.description: Refinance only: current loan balance in dollars (HUD 223(f) here allows no cash out). Default 0.

homes_on_site.description: Every home in the park, empty or not. Defaults to occupied_pads.

loan_wanted.description: Optional loan amount wanted, in dollars; each program says whether it covers it.

noi.description: Net operating income in dollars per year, after management and reserves, e.g. 268000. value_park_on_lot_rent can build it.

occupied_pads.description: Occupied pads, e.g. 68. Capped at total pads.

own_lender_amortization_years.description: Your lender's amortization in years. Default 25 (an example).

own_lender_dscr.description: Your lender's minimum debt service coverage, e.g. 1.30. Default 1.30 (an example).

own_lender_ltv_pct.description: Your bank or CMBS lender's max LTV in percent. Default 70 (an example; banks publish no single term).

owns_another_park.description: Whether the key principal owns at least one other park (Freddie Mac requires it). Omit if not known.

pads.description: Total pads (sites) in the park, e.g. 80.

park_owned_homes.description: Homes owned by the borrower, an affiliate or an outside investor. Default 0.

quality_level.description: Fannie Mae quality level from the lender's inspection, 1 to 5; 0 = not known (default).

spread_pct.description: Spread over Treasury in percent. Default 2.00, which is an example, not a quote.

term_years.description: Loan term in years: 5, 7 or 10. Picks the Treasury yield and Freddie Mac's LTV tier. Default 10.

value.description: Purchase price, or value if refinancing, in dollars, e.g. 3460000.

years_park_experience.description: Years the key principal has owned or run parks (Freddie Mac needs 2+). Omit if not known.
